c74object.name: mqtt.broker
c74object.description: Runs an MQTT broker on this computer. Clients on the network connect to it over TCP, TLS, WebSocket or secure WebSocket.

discussion.p: The broker implements MQTT 3.1.1 with Aedes in a Node for Max process: QoS 0, 1 and 2, retained messages, last wills and keepalive. It keeps its state in memory: retained messages and sessions are lost when it stops.
It starts when the object is created and listens on every port that is not 0. Changing an attribute restarts it. Port 1883 is MQTT's registered port; 8883 is the usual port for MQTT over TLS.

TLS and secure WebSocket need a private key and a certificate as PEM files. For a test, openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout key.pem -out cert.pem -days 365 -subj /CN=localhost creates both; clients must then accept the self-signed certificate.
With username, clients must log in: a wrong user name or password is refused with return code 4 (bad user name or password).
The broker is reachable from the local network. From other networks it needs port forwarding, a VPN or a relay. macOS asks once whether to accept incoming connections for the Node for Max process.
Clients see the broker's own state under $SYS/, e.g. a heartbeat every minute.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts listening with the current attributes. The broker also starts when the object is created.

method.name: stop
method.description: Disconnects all clients and stops listening.

method.name: clients
method.description: Sends clients with their number and client identifiers out the dumpout.

attribute.name: port
attribute.description: Port for MQTT over TCP, mqtt://. 0 for off.

attribute.name: tlsport
attribute.description: Port for MQTT over TLS, mqtts://. 0 for off. Needs key and cert.

attribute.name: wsport
attribute.description: Port for MQTT over WebSocket, ws://, e.g. for web pages served over HTTP. 0 for off.

attribute.name: wssport
attribute.description: Port for MQTT over secure WebSocket, wss://. 0 for off. Needs key and cert.

attribute.name: key
attribute.description: Path of the private key file (PEM).

attribute.name: username
attribute.description: User name clients must log in with. Empty for no login.

attribute.name: password
attribute.description: Password clients must log in with. Saved in the patch when typed into the object box.

entry.name: left outlet
entry.description: Clients: connected and disconnected with the client identifier; subscribe with the identifier, topic filter and QoS; unsubscribe with the identifier and topic filter.

entry.name: right outlet
entry.description: Dumpout: status listening with each scheme and port, or stopped; address with a URL for each network address of this computer; clients with their number; error with a text.
